whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Amit Martial Arts Academy,

I noticed your academy has stellar 5.0★ reviews in Ramkrishan Nagar, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new student inquiries and batch timings.

Maine aapke martial arts academy ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, self-defense programs, aur training schedules integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/amitsmartialarts

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Amit Martial Arts Academy team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your top-rated training programs in Ramkrishan Nagar. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact batch timings, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
